cta.title: Want intelligence tailored to your portfolio?
cta.body: Our Private Client Practice produces bespoke market briefings for principals, family offices, and institutional capital deploying into Dubai residential. Speak with us about a confidential consultation.

methodology: Methodology: Series tracks premium freehold residential averages — anchored to published peaks and troughs from DLD, ValuStrat, CBRE, Property Monitor, Primal Alliance and Engel & Völkers. Pre-2008 figures are estimates; 2012–2026 verified from transaction data. Q3 2025 cross-checks against Property Monitor at ~Dh 1,625/sqft. Forecast model: Smooth-growth mode applies weighted impacts from four levers with mean-reversion. "2008 Shock Replay" overrides this with the actual 2008–2012 year-on-year crash pattern applied forward from Q1 2026. Outputs are directional, for discussion — not investment advice.
